purpose: Development selection of people localization heads with current 360-second TRAIN passes
snapshot_weighting: Normalize all snapshots within each physical world; snapshots do not count as independent worlds
validation: 36 G41 development cases, 12 physical worlds, evaluated at 18000 ticks
targets_compared: Gaussian distance logit ranking with sigma 0.15m
features: Existing 32 spectral/thermal/acoustic proposal features; no coordinates or scene IDs
staging_rule: Complete first registered pass, one world per TRAIN family; no outcome selection. Replace staged roots with full cohorts in later fits, never double count.
selection: Minimum precision/recall across VALID area, node count and domain, then global criteria
acceptance: Fresh physical rollout and untouched final TEST still required after model selection
